put.description:
Status options: Active, Archived, Finalizing .
Archived Sessions may be deleted after a period of inactivity, and only the Session Owner or a user with FullControl can restore the Session to Active.
Finalizing status will kick out users who are currently in the Session, and prevent changes from being made to Session Files or Markups. Read-only operations can still be used (such as downloading files or creating a Session File Snapshot).
Notification boolean is used to subscribe to email notifications about changes to this Session. SuccessStatus possible values: Active, Archived, Finalizing
